content:
Aisha: mini desk tree OFF! 🎄 who wants in? tiny trees, paper triangles, fairy lights — anything that fits on your desk. winner gets a coffee voucher and eternal bragging rights :trophy:
Tom: i'm so in. already have a tiny succulent with a string of lights. will post pics later :camera_with_flash:
Ravi: can we do categories? best theme / most eco / funniest?
Aisha: yes — categories: 'Most Festive', 'Most Likely To Blow Up (battery lights)', and 'Most Upcycled'. voting via emoji reactions on photos. deadlines: post by friday 5pm PST.
Nina: love it. quick logistics Q — do we want a judge or purely community votes?
Aisha: community votes for 'People's Choice', but i'll recruit 2 judges for the 'Most Upcycled' category (volunteer: me + one more).
Tom: posting my pic in 10. tagging @here so remote folks see this.
Ravi: also, can we have a tiny desk background pack for the winners? i'll mock up 3 festive wallpapers if winners want them.
holiday-bot: Reminder: "Mini Desk Tree Off" submissions close in 48 hours. React to this message to RSVP.
Nina: RSVP'd ✅ — putting my origami forest on display.
Tom: posted photo: https://files.redwood.example/mini-tree-tom.jpg :sparkles:
Aisha: posted photo: https://files.redwood.example/mini-tree-aisha.jpg :evergreen_tree:
Ravi: posted photo: https://files.redwood.example/mini-tree-ravi.jpg — upcycled coffee tin base :recycle:
Nina: posted photo: https://files.redwood.example/mini-tree-nina.jpg — tiny paper cranes :crane:
Aisha: tagging judges: @Tom @Ravi please pick your fav for 'Most Upcycled' by reacting with :star: before friday.
Tom: reacted :star:
Ravi: reacted :star: (picked Nina's cranes)
Nina: omg thank you! good luck everyone :heart:
Aisha: final note — feel free to include a 1-line caption about your tree story when you post the pic. makes voting more fun :)
Tom: caption: "rescued lights from last year's office party + succulent cameo"
Ravi: caption: "coffee can -> tree stand, powered by leftover fairy lights"
Nina: caption: "origami therapy and paper cranes for world peace"
Aisha: awesome. see y'all in the photo thread and happy decorating :sparkler:
